today.text: every install meets a notification prompt, the tracking prompt and an account screen before the first question, then a paywall with a sample baby at week 42

asks: Who are you to the baby?
What are you expecting from the app?
Has your baby already been born?
What is your experience with similar apps?
So much advice out there – where do you usually learn about your baby’s growth?
Looking for simple ways to play with your baby?
During a baby leap, a baby may be fussy, eat less, or sleep poorly. Have you heard about these?
Babies often sleep poorly. Do you know any possible reasons?
Where do you keep notes about your baby’s health and development?
At what week was your baby born?
rebuild: the ad they tapped ticks their goal, and the trial opens on their own baby's week with a headline from that ad

ideas.title: Open the trial on their baby, not a sample
Ask about the baby before the account
Ask for notifications when you promise the reminder
Show the calendar you just built
